failure_and_publication_contract.download_failure_cleanup: close response and file handles, delete partial bytes, remove the owned reserved execution directory without ignore_errors, verify absence, and retain no receipt; cleanup failure raises loudly
failure_and_publication_contract.file_publication: same-directory fsynced temporary file plus hard-link no-replace for ledger, receipt, and completion marker
failure_and_publication_contract.hash_schema_parse_or_match_failure_clean: remove extracted/raw bytes and the owned reserved execution directory without ignore_errors, verify absence, and retain no ledger or receipt; cleanup failure raises loudly
failure_and_publication_contract.logging_rule: Log only phase names, catalog IDs, byte/row counts, hashes, and sanitized aggregate counts; never log exception values from rows.
failure_and_publication_contract.output_reservation: os.mkdir exact output directory after authorization as an atomic no-replace reservation
failure_and_publication_contract.redirect_and_retry_rule: A no-redirect urllib opener rejects every 30x before a second request; a shared GET budget permits exactly two attempted requests and no retry path exists.
failure_and_publication_contract.successful_raw_cleanup: remove all full publisher and extracted FITS bytes without ignore_errors, verify private staging absence, then publish the completion marker

future_execution_contract.required_authorization_phrase: AUTHORIZE RUN ACT_DR6_ERASS1_OVERLAP_V2_RUN_001: ACT/eRASS CATALOG-ONLY OVERLAP V2; DOWNLOAD 2 FULL CATALOG FILES AS OPAQUE TEMPORARY BYTES (EXACTLY 2 GET CALLS, 33,469,695 NETWORK BYTES, 15,994 CATALOG ROWS), DECODE ONLY THE FROZEN ALLOWLIST, AND MAKE NO HEAD, REDIRECT, OR RETRY CALLS AND NO MAP, PROFILE, THERMODYNAMIC, LENSING, INFERRED-MASS, SCORING, MODEL, OR PAID CALLS.

limitations: This receipt freezes an executor and authorization schema; it is not authorization and no catalog request has occurred.
The raw publisher files contain scientific columns as opaque bytes, but a future authorized run keeps them temporary, never decodes forbidden values, and deletes them before publication.
X-COP exclusion is exact-name/alias based; coordinate-only exclusion remains unavailable without a separately frozen X-COP coordinate ledger.
Even a post-X-COP count at or above 192 is only a catalog population upper bound and does not establish complete thermodynamic/profile packets.

projection_contract.archive_rule: The eRASS tar archive may contain safe directories and exactly one regular FITS member whose basename is erass1cl_main_v3.2.fits. Reject every other non-directory member, including extra regular files, symbolic links, hard links, devices, FIFOs and special entries; also reject traversal, POSIX absolute, pathlib absolute, Windows drive-qualified or UNC paths, NUL names, and size overflow.
projection_contract.opaque_raw_byte_rule: Full publisher files necessarily contain forbidden columns as opaque source bytes. They may exist only in the private temporary execution directory, are hashed without decoding, and are deleted before successful publication. Final outputs contain no raw catalog bytes.
projection_contract.parser_rule: Inspect FITS header/schema metadata; require the exact source-bound TFORM spelling, code and repeat for every allowlisted column; reject malformed suffixes, duplicate structural/indexed cards before dictionary insertion, all allowlisted TSCALn/TZEROn/TNULLn/TDIMn cards, and any row-layout width mismatch; then seek directly to allowlisted fixed-width column slices for each row. Wrap schema, type and coercion failures in value-free custom errors. Never decode, instantiate, include in an exception, log, or emit a forbidden scientific value.
projection_contract.row_layout_rule: The sum of every declared TFORM width must equal NAXIS1 exactly; implicit or trailing row padding is forbidden.
projection_contract.scaling_and_null_rule: Reject TSCALn, TZEROn, TNULLn and TDIMn for every allowlisted column; no scaling, integer-null sentinel, or array-shape semantics are frozen.

schema_metadata_sources.applicability: NASA LAMBDA states the Legacy catalog contains exactly the same information and columns as the full DR6 v1.0 catalog; the official full-catalog FITS-header page supplies the frozen TFORMs.
The official eROSITA DR1 primary-cluster-catalog data model supplies the frozen TFORMs.

sanitized_output_contract.claim_ceiling: A version-bound catalog-overlap upper bound and X-COP name/alias exclusion audit only; not profile completeness, independent replication readiness, physical-model evidence, or a CP3/CP7 completion claim.
forbidden_output_fields: SNR, flags, EXT_LIKE, DET_LIKE, PCONT or warning text
mass, radius, SZ amplitude, count rate, flux, luminosity, temperature, gas mass, gas fraction or PDFs
map, profile, thermodynamic, lensing, residual, candidate prediction or score values

act_selection: Legacy file membership is the frozen fixed_SNR>5.5, flags==0, footprint_Legacy=true base
warnings containing Possible projected system are quarantined
selection_match_and_exclusion_contract.coordinate_radius: theta_match(z)=max(1.22 arcmin, angular size of 0.5 Mpc at ACT z)
erass_selection: PCONT recorded only for private quality validation and never emitted or thresholded
selection_match_and_exclusion_contract.global_erass_identity_rule: Group every unique positional match by DETUID before X-COP or eligibility adjudication; any reused DETUID is quarantined, and any X-COP identity in the group propagates exclusion to the whole group.
selection_match_and_exclusion_contract.name_canonicalization: NFKD, ASCII, uppercase, remove punctuation/whitespace; ABELL/ACO integer aliases map to A{integer}; ZwCl1215 variants map to ZW1215; RXCJ1825 variants map to RXC1825.
selection_match_and_exclusion_contract.pair_comparison_rule: Compare every eligible ACT row to every eligible eRASS row using wrapped-RA spherical haversine separation; stop before comparison 45,889,510. The ceiling equals the complete frozen 3,747 by 12,247 catalog product and is not a tuning budget.
selection_match_and_exclusion_contract.redshift_rule: Record absolute delta-z only as sanitized match evidence; do not impose a post-hoc ACT-eRASS redshift cut.
selection_match_and_exclusion_contract.unique_match_rule: Accept exactly one eligible eRASS row inside the radius. A normalized MATCH_NAME token is confirming evidence only and never breaks a positional tie.
selection_match_and_exclusion_contract.xcop_exclusion_rule: Before counting eligible overlap, compare canonicalized ACT name, eRASS NAME, and MATCH_NAME tokens to the 12 frozen X-COP identities and aliases. Exclude exact resolved identities; quarantine partial/ambiguous X-COP-like tokens; no coordinate-only X-COP exclusion is claimed without a separately frozen X-COP coordinate ledger.
